A 14-year-old boy has been found after he was reported missing on Friday afternoon.

ACT Policing identified the boy, who had not been seen or heard from since 3.00pm Friday, June 19, 2026. He was last seen in Gold Creek.

His family and police held concerns for his welfare, but the boy was found safe and well.

He seen wearing black track pants, a black puffer jacket, and a black backpack.

The teenager is described as Caucasian in appearance, about 170cm (5'7") tall, with a solid build and ginger mid-length hair, police said.
